Formula 0.1.62

  • Ideas: the builder makes technical choices itself; when it truly cannot, it asks you or an engineer on Slack and carries on with the reply (#119)
  • Chat: say what you need and Formula picks the path, with a new Deep thinker and Researcher (#121)
  • Ideas: an idea shows its ticket, can start from one, and Formula files one for you (#120)
